purpose: bounded causal diagnosis of endpoint projection and interval radiance handling on two archived development episodes
direct_state_sampling: all exact state_control_trace rows in the interval; no synthetic or interpolated states

causal_input.representation: five causal 5 ms bins, two polarities, 64x64, log1p counts

response.radiance_source: Genesis native float32 scene-linear HDR renderer output

sources.original_sparse_100hz_plugin: existing frozen plugin, adaptive sample count and next_primary composition
sources.frozen_reconstruction_exact_rows: frozen projected warp sampled only at exact saved state timestamps
sources.endpoint_projection_identity_exact_rows: same warp but only mathematical source endpoints use exact identity projection; the alpha=1 output remains generated by the warp
sources.endpoint_exact_only_exact_rows: exact source image at mathematical endpoints, projected warp in intermediate motion; no intermediate coordinate rounding
sources.log_radiance_with_cached_render_fallback: log-radiance blend only on same-label, depth-consistent visible pixels; uncertain pixels use exact cached direct render and incur a measured full-frame render request
sources.exact_state_direct_render: native HDR direct renders of all exact trace rows, passed through the same DVS response
sources.archived_direct_hdr_2khz_reference: existing archived raw event stream, time-cropped for event and voxel context

models.shared_input: the same event-source tensor per model and query; events only

boundaries.physics: replay immutable logged states offline; no physics advance or new rollout
boundaries.geometry_gt: used inside Ours reconstruction and for post-inference scoring only
boundaries.uncertainty: unresolved visibility/label/depth pixels remain explicit render requests; exact cached state render is used only for diagnostic fallback fill
boundaries.rank: development diagnosis only, not generator ranking or checkpoint selection
